entities.name: Ciphering start procedure
entities.description: Procedure for starting ciphering and deciphering of NAS messages after secure exchange is established for a NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message that may be partially ciphered when including ESM message container or NAS message container.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message that is always sent unciphered.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message that is always sent unciphered.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message sent unciphered by MME even after ciphering has started.

entities.name: ESM message container
entities.description: Information element whose value part is ciphered in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: Information element whose value part is ciphered in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: Null ciphering algorithm EEA0
entities.description: Ciphering algorithm that may be configured when network operates without ciphering. NAS messages with security header indicating ciphering are regarded as ciphered even when EEA0 is used.

entities.name: Secure exchange established
entities.description: Condition indicating that secure exchange of NAS messages has been established for a NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Discard unprotected messages
entities.description: Behavior where receiver discards unciphered NAS messages that should have been ciphered according to specification rules.

relations.description: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains ESM message container IE.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains NAS message container IE.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message may be partially ciphered using current ciphering algorithm.
ATTACH REQUEST message is always sent unciphered.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message is always sent unciphered.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is sent unciphered by MME even after ciphering has started.
Ciphering start procedure requires that secure exchange of NAS messages has been established.
Once secure exchange is established, receiver discards unciphered messages that should have been ciphered.
Even with null ciphering algorithm EEA0, NAS messages with security header indicating ciphering are regarded as ciphered.
